verdict.rationale: An API reference exists for the Computer Analytics endpoint, with a parameter-level page under /api-reference/, documented GET endpoints, and a public OpenAPI spec at docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, coverage beyond the analytics endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
